name: analog-attach
description: Configure devices with a command line and a browser GUI: Linux devicetree overlays

scripts.build:cli: yarn run build:linux-lib && yarn run build:capi-lib && yarn workspace @analog-attach/cli build
scripts.build:binary: yarn run build:cli && yarn workspace @analog-attach/cli build:binary
scripts.test: yarn workspace linux-lib test --run && yarn workspace @analog-attach/cli test --run && yarn workspace capi-lib test --run
scripts.test-clean: yarn clean && yarn install && yarn build && yarn test
scripts.clean:all: yarn run clean && rm -rf node_modules packages/node_modules
